title: When Can We Trust LLMs in Mental Health? Large-Scale Benchmarks for Reliable LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the signed mean difference between LLM judge ratings and human expert ratings across cognitive and affective attributes on a 1-5 scale to quantify systematic leniency, inflation, or severity in automated evaluations.
Excluding self-evaluations from all calculations to prevent confounds and score inflation that occur when an LLM judge evaluates responses generated by its own model family.
